selection_reason: APM-02 completed_verified in PR #423. CSW-01 and CSW-02 are already completed_verified, satisfying CSW-03 dependencies; the owner-approved interleave selects CSW-03 next.
objective: Define Idea Inbox and Inspiration Engine so a minimal thought can be captured with near-zero friction, triaged into CSW-01 Creative Fragments/Projects, and developed through deterministic prompts/tables/combinators plus optional AI suggestions, while every suggestion remains attributable pre-authoritative material and the system avoids duplicate/truth/visibility bleed.
completion_gate: A minimal idea can be captured and developed into attributable alternatives with deterministic non-AI tools and optional suggestion assistance without automatically creating authoritative content, duplicating existing work or leaking protected source material.
required_design_questions: What is the lowest-friction capture path and minimum required metadata?
How does Inbox triage map into CSW-01 fragment kind/lifecycle/project/collection without forcing early structure?
Which deterministic inspiration tools are broadly useful across genres/settings?
How are random/seeded prompt results reproducible when desired without making them authoritative?
How are multiple alternatives/branches saved without overwriting the seed idea?
How are duplicate/related-material candidates surfaced using CSW-02 without silent merge?
How are references/source inspiration/provenance recorded without copying protected content?
How does optional AI receive authorized context and produce candidates with provenance and no automatic save/apply?
How are ‘develop this’ loops bounded so they do not endlessly generate noise or overwrite creator intent?
How do accessibility, mobile quick capture, offline draft capture and recovery behave?
next_action: Execute CSW-03 as a bounded design/governance tranche defining frictionless capture, Inbox triage, deterministic inspiration primitives, optional AI suggestion/provenance, branching/alternatives, duplicate/related checks, accessibility/offline draft recovery and explicit save/apply boundaries.
